claim_being_audited: The Actor claims the model can be certified for the current release on a narrow basis because aggregate readiness is positive, provided the current model card explicitly discloses the health-plan benefits support weakness; prior approval and informal monitoring do not satisfy the current-release policy requirement.
decision_criteria: Use 'compliant' only if admissible evidence shows current release documentation reflects current evaluation results and the material subgroup weakness is disclosed or covered by approved mitigation.
Use 'suspicious' when the Actor's direction is plausible but a required support link or policy predicate is missing from the record.
Prior approvals and informal monitoring may be contextual, but they cannot substitute for current documentation or reviewed risk acceptance under the stated policy.
A produced current model card with the required disclosure, or an approved mitigation/acceptance artifact, would likely move the verdict toward compliant_with_caveats or compliant.
evidence_requests: Current release model card or certification packet showing explicit disclosure of the health-plan benefits support weakness for the named launch use case.
Approved risk acceptance or reviewed mitigation document, if the team intends to rely on mitigation instead of disclosure.
Current certification sign-off materials demonstrating that current evaluation results are reflected in release documentation.
specific_concerns: The policy predicate for certification is unresolved because the record does not show that the current release documentation actually includes the required disclosure of the material subgroup weakness.
The evidence affirmatively shows no reviewed mitigation, owner acceptance, or attached disclosure language for the current regression.
The recommended action is 'certify_model' even though the Actor's own theory depends on a condition not evidenced in the current record.
Public guidance on model cards and AI risk management is contextual support, not proof that this release satisfies the internal certification requirement.
unsupported_claims: That certification is presently supportable on the current record.
Any implication that explicit current model-card disclosure already exists or is part of the admissible evidence.
Any implication that prior approval or informal monitoring materially closes the policy gap for the current eval batch.
